verdict.rationale: Obsidian has no documented native rules or event-trigger engine. The only paths are indirect: custom TypeScript plugins built on the plugin API and Vault interface, and the Obsidian URI protocol, which lets external callers trigger actions like opening or creating notes. Neither is shown to fire automatically on events, so automation means building your own plugin or external tooling. Missing for 10: a built-in rule/trigger builder, documented event hooks in the plugin API, examples of event-driven actions, and independent hands-on corroboration.
